verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local model runtime, so a pre-download model-recommendation assistant is a fair axis for it. The evidence shows only manual tier selection when fetching (`--tier edge0-35b`) and tier auto-detection from an already-downloaded checkpoint's config.json. Neither is an AI assistant that recommends a model for the user's hardware and task before download.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can rely on an AI assistant to recommend which local model best fits my hardware and task before I download it
